note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Organization.Read.All, User.Read -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
# safety net: checkpoint of the shared domain controller before anything is written to AD
Invoke-Command -Session $s { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\mg | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\mg\src -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $s { Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe' })) { if (-not (Test-Path $msi)) { Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v$v/PowerShell-$v-win-x64.msi" -OutFile $msi }; Copy-Item -ToSession $s -Path $msi -Destination C:\mg\pwsh.msi -Force; Invoke-Command -Session $s { Start-Process msiexec.exe '/i C:\mg\pwsh.msi /quiet ADD_PATH=1 ENABLE_PSREMOTING=1' -Wait } }
# seed the lab OU (six disabled hy.* accounts) and register the tenant's initial domain as a UPN suffix (removed in teardown)
# Exchange Online: departments (previous values saved for teardown), shared mailbox mglab-finance with sam.demo as delegate

if (-not (Get-Mailbox -Identity "mglab-finance@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { New-Mailbox -Shared -Name 'MG Lab Finance' -DisplayName 'MG Lab Finance' -Alias mglab-finance | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 20 }; Add-MailboxPermission -Identity "mglab-finance@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN" -User "sam.demo@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN" -AccessRights FullAccess -InheritanceType All -AutoMapping $false | Out-Null

Remove-VMCheckpoint -VMName CON-DC01 -Name pre-mglab-ep17   # the safety-net checkpoint
